summary: Verified 4 reported bug fixes on ArtyFex SPA: (1) SPA client-side navigation preserved across /shop and footer Terms links via window marker, (2) mobile Sign-in visible in top nav + hamburger drawer, (3) footer Atelier links functional from /shop with correct URLs (/#craft, /#reviews, /shop), (4) new Admin Panel footer link routes to /admin. Zero console errors on /shop, /policies/privacy, /admin, /account.
passed: Desktop nav Shop click preserves window.__spa_marker (true SPA nav)
Footer 'The Collection' from /shop is client-side (marker preserved, url=/shop)
Footer bottom 'Terms' link is client-side (marker preserved, url=/policies/terms)
Footer 'The Craft' from /shop navigates to /#craft (works from non-home page)
Footer 'Collectors' from /shop navigates to /#reviews (works from non-home page)
Footer 'Admin Panel' link visible on home & routes to /admin
Mobile (375x812) [data-testid=nav-account] visible (40x36 icon) and opens AuthDialog
Mobile hamburger opens menu with [data-testid=nav-account-mobile] full-width 'Sign in / Create account' button visible
notes: Note: Footer '#craft' / '#reviews' anchors are plain <a> tags so from a non-home route they trigger a document navigation to '/' + hash (per plan expectation) — NOT tested as pure SPA. 'The Collection', 'Terms', 'Privacy', 'Refunds' and Admin Panel are all <Link> and confirmed client-side.
